Maya Patel: Quick check — changelog cutoff is tomorrow 10:00am PT. Need final thumbs on sample apps, quickstarts, and SDK changelog entries. Who owns the stability hitlist and last-minute QA? cc @Alex Chen @Priya Rao
Alex Chen: I'm tracking the sampleapp issues. Have 3 PRs open, one failing CI (integration-tests/sample-run). Will push fix tonight. ETA 21:00 PT :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Priya Rao: SDK changelog done, awaiting release note sign-off from docs. One breaking change note added for ruby client. PR #482
Liam O'Neil: QA here — can take the sampleapp regression if Alex is fixing it. Can you paste failing test logs?
Alex Chen: failing test: ```FAIL test_sample_end_to_end (tests.e2e.test_sample) AssertionError: output mismatch
Traceback...
``` Fix is a typo in Dockerfile entrypoint, will open PR in 30m
Jamie Park: Docs: I've queued the changelog snippet and added a short migration guide. Need someone to sanity-check ruby wording. @Priya Rao
Priya Rao: happy to review ruby wording in 10 mins
Maya Patel: Ownership summary: sampleapps -> Alex, SDK changelog -> Priya, docs snippet & migration -> Jamie + Priya, QA sweep -> Liam. If anyone can't meet these, say now. :point_up:
Alex Chen: I can own sampleapps cut. Will ping when PR merged
Liam O'Neil: will run smoke suite after merge and post results here
ReleaseBot: Deploy window scheduled: 2026-03-18T18:00:00Z (changelog cutoff enforcement will block merges after 2026-03-18T17:00:00Z) :robot_face:
Docs CI: Changelog preview generation passed for branch 'main' — https://gi/preview/1234 :white_check_mark:
Maya Patel: OK — last ask: everyone please add a one-line 'what changed' summary to PR description for changelog parsing. Example: `chore(sdk): bump default timeout to 30s — user-visible change`
Alex Chen: done on my PRs
Priya Rao: added summaries
Jamie Park: added + small edit on ruby phrasing
Liam O'Neil: starting smoke run now, will report in 15m
Maya Patel: thanks team. I'll close the thread once all green. :pray:
